Branch.title: Branch
Branch.description: Represents a branch of the microfinance organization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Branch entity.

contactNumber.description: Contact phone number of the branch.

Area.title: Area
Area.description: Represents an area within the microfinance organization's hierarchy.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Area entity.

Zone.title: Zone
Zone.description: Represents a zone within the microfinance organization's hierarchy.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Zone entity.

Region.title: Region
Region.description: Represents a region within the microfinance organization's hierarchy.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Region entity.

Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: Represents an employee of the microfinance organization, linked to a Firebase Auth user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Employee Firestore document.

uid.description: The UID of the corresponding Firebase Authentication user.

bengaliName.description: Full name of the employee in Bengali.

email.description: The login email for the employee. Must be unique.

role.description: The assigned role of the employee.

assignment.description: The name of the Branch or 'Head Office' the employee is assigned to.

UserRole.title: UserRole
UserRole.description: Represents a user role within the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserRole entity.

name.description: Name of the user role (e.g., branch user, area user).

Group.title: Group
Group.description: Represents a group or center of members.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Group entity.

Member.title: Member
Member.description: Represents a member of a group.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Member entity.

contactNumber.description: Contact phone number of the member.

Loan.title: Loan
Loan.description: Represents a loan given to a group or member.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Loan entity.

loanDate.description: Date when the loan was given.

Savings.title: Savings
Savings.description: Represents savings of a group or member.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Savings entity.

savingsDate.description: Date when the savings were recorded.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to ensure a permanent and well-organized storage for the LendEasy application. It is structured to support the core features of branch, employee, user role, and group/center management while prioritizing security and scalability. The design focuses on path-based ownership for private user data and collaborative membership maps for group-related data.  Each collection is segregated based on security requirements. Crucially, authorization independence is achieved by denormalizing relevant authorization data into subcollections.  This avoids `get()` calls in security rules. The structure is optimized for efficient `list` operations with clear ownership and role-based access control.
